description: A Git menu for VS Code, with the common Git operations grouped in one place.
command.enableMainMenuBar: Add Git to Main Menu Bar
command.disableMainMenuBar: Remove Git from Main Menu Bar
config.title: Git Quick Menu
config.mainMenuBar: Show a **Git** menu in the main menu bar, between *Terminal* and *Help*. VS Code has no official API for this, so enabling it modifies a file of the VS Code installation (re-applied automatically after VS Code updates). Requires reloading the window.
config.showStatusBarItem: Show a "Git" item in the status bar that opens the Git menu.
config.showInEditorTitle: Show the Git submenu in the editor title bar.
config.showInSourceControl: Show the Git submenu in the Source Control view title.
config.logMaxEntries: Maximum number of commits listed by View Branch History.
config.commitAfterMerge: Commit the result of a merge automatically. When off, merges stop before committing so the changes can be reviewed.
